appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Product Rating Share by Category'. Y-axis is labeled 'Value' with ticks 0 to 50. X-axis is labeled 'Category'.
Six blue circular markers appear above the categories Quality, Price, Design, Support, Delivery, and Other.
Percentage labels are printed directly above the markers: 14%, 49%, 30%, 33%, 29%, 34%.
The Price marker (49%) is the highest of the six, sitting near the 27 value level; the Quality marker (14%) is the lowest, near 13.

printed_facts.fact: Attribute follow-up rule: 'Select the category with the highest current labeled rating share'.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the Product Rating Share dashboard, then open the product attribute follow-up item for the category with the highest current labeled rating share.'
Primary field: 'Product attribute follow-up category' with options 'Select Price', 'Select Support', 'Select Design'.
Queue rule option: 'Prioritize highest current rating share'.
Work queue option: 'Product attribute follow-up queue'.
uncertain: The dashboard includes categories (Quality, Delivery, Other) that are not among the three selectable follow-up options; the rule's 'highest current labeled rating share' must be applied to determine which selectable category is intended.
Whether the 49% Price label is the intended 'highest current labeled rating share' for the follow-up queue, given that the option set does not include all dashboard categories.
